actionSelectionStep1Headline: What does it mean to associate actions?
actionSelectionConfigDialogStep2Headline: Would you like to associate actions from your catalog?
whatAreActionsText: Actions are units of automation or documentation that can be run or launched to diagnose or remediate an event.
whatAreActionAssociationsText: Actions can be associated with built-in or custom event types and can be run or launched from the occurrence of an event.
actionsAssociationsNote: Note that action associations are saved with the definition of the event.
targetAgentDescription: An Agent encapsulates 1..* Sensors, who in turn are able to raise Events to the Instana backend. A triggering Agent contains the Sensor that raised this particular Event.
actionSensorTimeout: Could not handle the backend request. Check your agent configuration to make sure the Action sensor is installed.

actionCannotBeUndone: This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?
